'''Fast-moving Probe Droids''' were a type of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]].<ref name="Hint Book" /> The cylindrical droids rolled back and forth over the ground in their assigned area, raising and lowering their bodies while moving. A number of these droids could be found on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="SWNES">[[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game (1991)]]</ref>
